author.name: Joseph Cox, Sam Cole, and Emanuel Maiberg

excerpt: As AI providers charge by the token, companies scramble to control the bill, including a tool that quietly rewrites AI output to be more terse.
summary: The 404 Media co-founders dig into what they call the tokenpocalypse: the scramble inside large companies to control AI spending now that providers charge per token. They cover the internal tactics being deployed to curb costs, including a tool that modifies AI output to be more terse, and close with a stranger story about fake AI-generated flower seeds being sold to unsuspecting buyers on major e-commerce platforms.
title: The Tokenpocalypse Is Here
